# netactuate_cloud_scaling_options (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Scaling Options visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_scaling_options" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID whose scaling options should be read.

### Optional

- `include_current_plan` (Boolean) Whether to include the current plan in the returned scaling options.
- `max_cpus` (Number) Maximum CPU filter for scaling options.
- `max_ram` (Number) Maximum RAM filter for scaling options.
- `min_cpus` (Number) Minimum CPU filter for scaling options.
- `min_ram` (Number) Minimum RAM filter for scaling options.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `raw_json` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by the API.
